verdict.rationale: Asking whether an accounting SaaS ships a built-in AI assistant is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows automated booking-category suggestions and automatic asset recognition from receipts. These are adjacent automation features, not an assistant the user can delegate tasks to, and nothing documents a built-in AI agent or chat assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
